newsitem.title: USA: Transcend COO Julian Cohen leaves company.
newsitem.headline: Transcend COO Julian Cohen leaves company.

text.p: Transcend Services Inc said Friday Julian Cohen, its chief operating officer, has decided to leave the company.
Cohen will not be replaced, Chief Financial Officer David =urphy said. Murphy said Larry Gerdes, company president and chief executive, is to assume Cohen's duties.
"It's really just a reorganization within the company," Murphy said.

Transcend also said Friday it signed four letters of intent with possible customers of $23.6 million and extended a three-year agreement with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp's Memorial Medical Center of Jacksonville, Fla., through February of 1999.
The company said it signed a contract with a Midwestern healthcare provider that will bring about $3.5 million in revenue over the three-years of the contract.
Transcend is a hospital services company focused on the outsourcing of health information management and related functions for healthcare providers.
